𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗖𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗬 𝗢𝗙 𝗖𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 💯

Sachin Tendulkar: 51 Test + 49 ODI hundreds = 100 international tons.
The only batter to reach 100. The 100th came at Mirpur, 16 March 2012. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #Tendulkar

👉 100va shatak: Bangladesh ke khilaf, Mirpur, 16 March 2012 (114 run)
